notes: PX4 runs this code only when it imports the stored parameters of a vehicle, as after a firmware upgrade in place. Loading a parameter file by name does not run it.

Each probe is one stored value imported on its own. param_find knows the parameters of this release's snapshot, and param_get returns their defaults; during a real import, param_get returns values imported earlier from the same storage, and a value set here can be overwritten by a stored value imported later.
A firmware built without some modules has fewer parameters, so code that checks whether a parameter exists can behave differently there.
What the firmware does with the values after the import (for example replacing -1 with a default) is not part of this data.
